info.title: workharbor API
info.description: The JSON API of `whr serve` (design §9.7). Served only on a unix socket, `api.sock` in the state directory (D29, §7.5), never on a network address; every route needs the bearer token. Responses are wrapped in the envelope of §9.2. Free text from agents, repositories and the forge (input, subject, message) is untrusted data.

post.summary: Recreate a workspace's environment from the image its repository resolves to now

200.description: the environments and images before and after

default.description: An error. The HTTP status follows the exit code: 400 usage (2), 401 auth (4), 404 not found (3), 409 conflict or needs human (5, 6), 504 timeout (7), 500 other.

post.description: Replaces the environment with one made from the image the repository's default branch resolves to now, keeping the home and build volumes and the workspace folder. Refused (409) while a run of the workspace is live, naming it. The old environment is removed only after the new one is up; if the new one cannot be brought up the old one is started again. Audited with both image digests. It takes minutes when the image has to be built.

200.description: First line: target envelope. Following lines: {"held":true} each second. Keep the response open until the runtime child exits; close it to release the environment hold. No terminal data.

default.description: An error. The HTTP status follows the exit code: 400 usage (2), 401 auth (4), 404 not found (3), 409 conflict or needs human (5, 6), 504 timeout (7), 500 other.

post.description: Requires Accept: application/x-ndjson. Restarts the idle environment and holds it through the response connection lifetime, excluding runs and rebuilds. The caller starts the runtime interactive exec as its child with fds 0 through 2 inherited directly; no terminal data crosses this API. The caller must end that child on EOF, lost connection, malformed heartbeat or no heartbeat for five seconds. Refused (409) while a run is unfinished. Opening records metadata only in the audit tier: workspace, environment, time and API caller. No secret is returned.

post.summary: Open a preview of a port of a task's environment
post.description: The port must be one the repository's environment declares (forwardPorts or customizations.workharbor.previewPorts, read from the default branch) and the environment must be running. The answer carries a link that opens the preview in a browser once, for five minutes; a second request returns the preview already open with a new link. Not idempotent on purpose: a stored answer would keep a link.

200.description: the certificate and the console's host key

post.description: Signs the client's public key into a certificate for the principal `whr`, valid for minutes, and returns it with the console's host key, which the client pins. The private key stays with the client. The console must be open. Every certificate is audited.

get.summary: Carry one SSH connection to the console's sshd as a byte stream

101.description: Switching Protocols: the connection is now the SSH protocol, to and from an sshd that runs for it in the console

default.description: An error. The HTTP status follows the exit code: 400 usage (2), 401 auth (4), 404 not found (3), 409 conflict or needs human (5, 6), 504 timeout (7), 500 other.

get.description: Ask for the upgrade with `Connection: Upgrade` and `Upgrade: whr-ssh/1`. After the 101 the bytes are the SSH protocol, unframed, in both directions: the client is an `ssh` whose ProxyCommand is `whr ssh --proxy`. The console listens on no port; the sshd runs once per connection, as the console user, and accepts only a certificate this supervisor signed.

get.description: The tokens, the cost and the number of turns the agents reported, grouped, from the audit entries (design §5.7). A row is one group and one auth mode, so the notional cost of a subscription is never added to the spend of an API key; a turn without tokens or without a cost is counted, not read as zero. `windows` are the account's own usage windows and `balance` the latest balance the agent reported, if it reported one.

get.summary: Open a shell in the console as a terminal stream

101.description: Switching Protocols: the connection is now a terminal stream

default.description: An error. The HTTP status follows the exit code: 400 usage (2), 401 auth (4), 404 not found (3), 409 conflict or needs human (5, 6), 504 timeout (7), 500 other.

get.description: Needs `Connection: Upgrade` and `Upgrade: whr-terminal/1`. Everything that can fail does so as an ordinary error before the upgrade. The answer is `101 Switching Protocols`, and then the connection carries frames both ways: one type byte, a four-byte big-endian length and the payload (at most 64 KiB). The client sends data (`D`, the terminal's input) and its size (`R`, two big-endian uint16: columns, rows); the server sends data (`D`, the terminal's output) and, last, the exit code (`X`, a big-endian int32). A client that disconnects hangs the terminal up. The route is behind the API token, which listens on loopback only: a web session does not reach it.

get.summary: The dashboard's usage card for a period
get.description: What every agent used over today, 7 days, 30 days or all time, in the supervisor's time zone: in total, by agent and by model, each row with its cache share and a cost label (reported, estimated, mixed or none). Built from the audit entries, so a transcript purge does not change it.

default.description: An error envelope.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: The first request with a key runs; the same key and request returns the stored response (header Idempotent-Replay: true); the same key with another request is a conflict.

terminal_reason.description: Immutable initiating terminal reason; absent for an unfinished run or unknown legacy reason. Cleanup warnings are separate.

duration_ms.description: Supervisor elapsed lifetime high-water mark in milliseconds, including pause and downtime. Absent when duration bounds are unknown.

files.description: files the revision changes; 0 when not measured

input_truncated.description: The input is cut: it is only the start of what the agent asked for, and an allow allows all of it.

check.description: The receipt of the check that ran on the candidate (design 4.5, D51): which commit, by what and with what result. The output is the tail of what the check printed, untrusted data.

publish_attempts.description: The candidate's failed publish steps, oldest first: a transport fault that left the publish outstanding, or the refusal that ended it.

usage_line.description: the task's usage line (design 5.7); absent when it has no usage

agent_may_run.description: Recorded stop failures, including their run and untrusted error text.

run_id.description: absent when the task is held

held.description: true when the issue's author is not trusted: nothing was started and decision_id is a question for the human (start or cancel)

path.description: an empty folder below a workspace root

source.description: a repository path or an https URL

role.description: the agent whose branch to open; empty means the workspace's only agent

warnings.description: files in the copy that an editor may act on by itself; untrusted text

agent_may_run.description: Tasks whose agent stop and environment stop both failed: the agent may still run.

agent_stop_pending.description: Tasks whose starting agent stop is deferred until the session attaches.

port.description: The app's port in the environment.

listen_port.description: The loopback port the preview listens on: the origin's port, which the forwarder maps.

estimated_micro_usd.description: Cost of turns whose figure is an estimate; never added to reported_micro_usd.

api_ms.description: Time on the model API the agent reported, in milliseconds.

wall_ms.description: Wall time the agent reported, in milliseconds.

cache_share.description: Share of input tokens served from the cache; absent when none were reported.

public_key.description: one public key line (ed25519, ECDSA, or RSA of at least 3072 bits)

forwarding.description: allow port forwarding to the console's own loopback

certificate.description: one authorized_keys line, the contents of a *-cert.pub file

host_key.description: the console's host public key, one line, to pin

estimated_micro_usd.description: Cost of turns whose figure is an estimate; never added to reported_micro_usd.

api_ms.description: Time on the model API the agent reported, in milliseconds.

wall_ms.description: Wall time the agent reported, in milliseconds.

cache_share.description: Share of input tokens served from the cache; absent when none were reported.

total.description: One row per auth mode: a subscription's notional cost is never added to an API key's spend.

subscription.description: Some turns ran on a subscription: the usage windows lead and the cost is API-equivalent, not billed.

code.description: The commits a human approved in the period: how many, and the files and lines of their diff stats, from the review.approved audit entries.
